integrity: The infinite statement is proved directly by interval induction and base-\(p\) uniqueness. Finite enumeration is supplementary only. A residual access risk remains for the inaccessible full text of Stewart (1954), whose criterion was checked through an inspected open full-text restatement.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to integers with exact prime support contained in \(\{2,p\}\) and uses the binary structure of the \(2\)-power divisor layers. It does not assert a comparable dichotomy for three-prime support.
title: Complete-or-injective divisor subset sums on \(2^a p^b\)
